Step 1: Sydney is UTC+10 (historical time zone not exact, but assume modern for this problem). Athens is UTC+2 (DST not applicable in 1784).  
Step 2: Time difference = Athens − Sydney = UTC+2 − UTC+10 = −8 hours.  
Step 3: 11:00 Sydney − 8 hours = 03:00 same day (June 10, 1784).  
Step 4: No date change because subtracting 8 hours from 11:00 still lands on June 10.  

FINAL_ANSWER: 1784-06-10 03:00
